title: feat(nuclk): nu as clock and as filter fires on all 12 hosts
science: Repeats the 12-host clock-vs-readiness split with the support-drop cost nu instead of rho: N_label_fire=12 AND N_filt_fire=12. Cross-cell contrast with #6709 (rho gave 4/12) plus a derived reason: on all 12 hosts the unread center has coordinate support 3 and every occupied neighbor support 2 or 3, so none of nu's three clauses can fire inward and every incoming nu=1. Conclusion: nu is consistent as clock AND as readiness gate, rho is not.
